desc: Implement NTT for polynomial multiplication modulo 998244353.
Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to N.
Group numbers by digit length, compute c_l, sum_l, and 10^l mod MOD.
Build polynomial A(t) by multiplying (1 + t * 10^l)^{c_l} for each group, truncated to degree N.
Compute the series C(t) = sum_{m=0}^{N-1} (-1)^m * sum_l sum_l * 10^l * (10^l)^m t^m.
Multiply A(t) and C(t) using NTT to get D(t), then B_k = D_{k-1}.
Compute the final sum using the formula with factorials and modulo arithmetic.
Test with sample inputs to verify correctness.
